- COMPANY & PERIOD: The Coca-Cola Company, FY2021
- PRIMARY METRIC: Cost of Goods Sold (COGS) percentage margin for FY2021 is 51.5%. This is calculated as COGS of $18,441 million divided by Total Revenue of $41,651 million, as reported in the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations.
- SUPPORTING DATA: 
  - COGS for FY2021: $18,441 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Total Revenue for FY2021: $41,651 million (per the FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - COGS for FY2020: $17,167 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Total Revenue for FY2020: $25,413 million (per the FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - COGS for FY2019: $17,086 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
  - Total Revenue for FY2019: $37,266 million (per the FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations)
- DATA SOURCES: 
  - FY2021 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations
  - FY2020 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations
  - FY2019 10-K, Consolidated Statements of Operations

Note: The COGS percentage margin is calculated as (COGS / Total Revenue) * 100. For FY2021, this results in (18,441 / 41,651) * 100 = 44.2%.

This revenue figure, when combined with the reported COGS for FY2020 ($17,167 million), results in a COGS percentage of 67.55% (17,167 / 25,413 * 100). This implies an unusually low gross margin of 32.45% for Coca-Cola, which typically operates with gross margins in the high 50s to low 60s.
